levelledPara.title: Safety and Operational Constraints BREX
levelledPara.para: This BREX defines safety, warning, and operational constraint requirements for ATA 31 (Indicating/Recording) AMM data modules. It ensures consistent safety messaging and prevents ambiguous operational instructions.

levelledPara.title: Mandatory Warnings for Live Displays
levelledPara.para: All procedures involving live cockpit displays must include the following warning:

WARNING: Live displays may present flight-critical information. Do not perform maintenance on display systems while aircraft is in operation or during critical flight phases. Ensure all display power is removed and locked out before beginning maintenance.
This warning must appear before any procedure involving:
- Engine Indication and Crew Alerting System (EICAS) maintenance

levelledPara.title: Mandatory Warnings for Data Recording Systems
levelledPara.para: All procedures involving data recording systems must include appropriate warnings:

WARNING (for FDR/CVR): Flight Data Recorder and Cockpit Voice Recorder are crash-protected equipment. Do not compromise crash protection features. Ensure proper installation and security of mounting hardware.
WARNING (for data interference): Do not interrupt data recording during aircraft operation. Loss of flight data may compromise accident investigation capabilities and violate regulatory requirements.
CAUTION (for data integrity): Ensure proper grounding and EMI protection for all recording equipment. Electromagnetic interference may corrupt recorded data.

levelledPara.title: Standardized Safety Phrasing
levelledPara.para: All warnings and cautions must use standardized phrasing:

levelledPara.title: Prohibited Ambiguous Language
levelledPara.para: The following ambiguous terms are PROHIBITED in ATA 31 AMM procedures:
- "may" (implies optional action; use "can" for capability or "must"/"shall" for requirement)

levelledPara.title: Required Safety Verifications
levelledPara.para: All maintenance procedures must include verification steps:
- Proper tool removal and FOD check

levelledPara.title: Electrical Safety Requirements
levelledPara.para: All electrical work on indicating/recording systems must include:
WARNING: High voltage present. Ensure all power sources are disconnected and verified de-energized before beginning work. Follow lock-out/tag-out procedures per AMM Chapter 24.
CAUTION: Static-sensitive components. Use proper ESD protection. Ground yourself and use ESD-safe work surface before handling electronic components.

levelledPara.title: Regulatory Compliance Notices
levelledPara.para: Where applicable, procedures must note regulatory requirements:
- FAA Part 43 (Maintenance, preventive maintenance, rebuilding, and alteration)
